changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: On-farm evaluation OFSP clones
study.description: On-farm tricot trials with a total of 4 WFSP clones and 1 common check (Irene) clone evaluated in 20 districts of Mozambique. Four farmers per district host the trials. Districts used for on-farm trials evaluate are in Inhambane, Manica, Sofala, Zambezia and Niassa provinces. Each farmer receive a unique package of 3 clones. Agronomic data collected included storage root yield, foliage yield and number of roots per plant. Quality traits to be assessed include sweet taste, mealiness, firmness and browning. Ranking of clones will be done at harvest.

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised
